nodes.description: Mapping of token balances; written arbitrarily by setFeeTransfer and updated in _transfer/_burn/constructor.
Total token supply, set in the Burnout constructor and reduced in _burn.
uint8 transaction fee in thousandths, readable by anyone and settable only by owner.
Address receiving collected fees; owner-controlled and used in _transfer.
Whitelist mapping of senders exempt from fees, read in calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Whitelist mapping of recipients exempt from fees, read in calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Flag gating further whitelist additions; disabled forever by renounceFeeWhitelist.
Owner address from Ownable, compared with _msgSender() in the ownerOnly modifier.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public transferFrom that calls _transfer then decreases allowance via _approve and SafeMath.sub.
Public approve that calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Internal transfer applying the deflationary fee; debits sender, credits recipient and optionally the feeDistributor.
Internal burn that reduces _balances and _totalSupply with SafeMath.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances with zero-address checks.
View helper computing fee = amount.mul(txFee).div(1000) and returning transfer amount plus fee.
Owner-only setter for txFee.
Owner-only setter for the feeDistributor address.
Owner-only whitelist toggle for feeless senders, gated by canFeeWhitelist.
Owner-only whitelist toggle for feeless recipients, gated by canFeeWhitelist.
Owner-only function that directly assigns a caller-supplied value to an arbitrary balance entry.
Owner-only function permanently setting canFeeWhitelist to false.
Public burn that destroys _msgSender()'s tokens via _burn.
Burnout constructor minting initialTokens to msg.sender and setting _totalSupply.
Public allowance increase using SafeMath.add before _approve.
Public allowance decrease using SafeMath.sub before _approve.
Access-control modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender() before executing the body.
msg.sender / _msgSender(), attacker-influenced caller identity used for auth and transfers.
Unchecked privileged write _balances[_feeDistributor] = feeValue that can mint or overwrite any balance.
Sequence of balance state updates in _transfer (debit sender, credit recipient, credit feeDistributor).
Fee arithmetic amount.mul(txFee).div(1000) with truncation to zero for small amounts.
Balance and totalSupply state updates in _burn using SafeMath subtraction.
Local in _transfer holding the post-fee amount credited to the recipient.
Local in _transfer holding the fee amount credited to the feeDistributor.
Local in calculateAmountsAfterFee holding amount.mul(txFee).div(1000).
Parameter of setFeeTransfer selecting the balance slot to overwrite.
Parameter of setFeeTransfer providing the raw value written into _balances.

edges.reason: ownerOnly compares _owner with _msgSender(), letting the caller identity decide whether privileged functions execute.
_owner is read inside the ownerOnly check against _msgSender().
setFee is guarded by ownerOnly.
setFeeDistributor is guarded by ownerOnly.
setFeelessSender is guarded by ownerOnly.
setFeelessReciever is guarded by ownerOnly.
setFeeTransfer, the arbitrary balance writer, is guarded by ownerOnly.
renounceFeeWhitelist is guarded by ownerOnly.
setFeeTransfer executes the unchecked privileged balance write.
Caller-supplied _feeDistributor selects which balance slot is overwritten.
Caller-supplied feeValue is written directly into _balances.
Arbitrary value is stored into the _balances mapping without supply-consistent accounting.
The privileged caller identity from msg.sender gates who can execute the balance overwrite.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.
burn passes _msgSender() as the account whose tokens are destroyed.
Burnout constructor mints initialTokens to msg.sender.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer with the given sender and recipient.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve after the transfer.
approve routes through _approve.
increaseAllowance adds to the allowance with SafeMath before storing via _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the allowance with SafeMath before storing via _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
burn delegates to the internal _burn.
_transfer calls calculateAmountsAfterFee to split amount into transfer and fee.
_transfer performs the balance debit/credit sequence.
Balance state updates read and write the _balances mapping.
transferToAmount is added into the recipient's _balances entry.
transferToFeeDistributorAmount is added into the feeDistributor's _balances entry.
_transfer obtains transferToAmount from calculateAmountsAfterFee.
_transfer obtains transferToFeeDistributorAmount from calculateAmountsAfterFee.
calculateAmountsAfterFee multiplies and divides to derive the fee.
fee local is produced by the multiply/divide fee computation.
The fee local carries the truncated arithmetic result used to derive state changes.
txFee is read as the multiplier in the fee calculation.
The arithmetic operation consumes the mutable txFee state variable.
feelessSender short-circuits the fee calculation for whitelisted senders.
feelessReciever short-circuits the fee calculation for whitelisted recipients.
feeDistributor address gates crediting of the collected fee inside _transfer.
_burn performs SafeMath subtraction on balance and supply.
Burn reduces the caller's _balances entry.
Burn reduces _totalSupply.
Burnout constructor assigns the initial balance to msg.sender.
Burnout constructor sets _totalSupply to initialTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Local transferToAmount only exists inside _transfer; fold it into the enclosing core function node.
Local transferToFeeDistributorAmount only exists inside _transfer; fold it into the enclosing core function node.
Local fee is produced and consumed only inside calculateAmountsAfterFee; fold it into that core function node.
Parameter _feeDistributor belongs to setFeeTransfer; fold it into the core function node.
Parameter feeValue is the value written by the unsafe balance write; fold it into that unsafe_operation node.
